**`run.Session`** in `lab/internal/run/run.go:178` is the supervisor: it prepares an immutable run directory, writes `prompt.txt`, streams the child's stdout/stderr to `dir/raw/`, and on return writes the self-describing `run-meta.json` (`writeMeta`, `lab/internal/run/run.go:334`) recording outcome, exit code, wall set vs. time taken, command/args, and arm.

The actual child spawn and wall enforcement live in the unexported **`run.spawn`** (`lab/internal/run/run.go:277`), which reports back an `endedBy` (`lab/internal/run/run.go:233`) that `outcomeOf` (`lab/internal/run/run.go:245`) turns into `completed` / `failed` / `cannot finish at budget` / `interrupted` (`lab/internal/run/run.go:30`). The wall clock starts at spawn (`wallStartsAtSpawn`, `lab/internal/run/run.go:162`), and the process group used for killing is set in `setProcessGroup` (`lab/internal/run/proc_unix.go:17`).
